visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person with long black hair, wearing dark sunglasses and a black kimono-style robe, stands in the center of a well-lit indoor space. In the background, a warm light fixture with three globes is mounted on a grey concrete-textured wall. To the person's left, a light-colored acoustic guitar sits on a stand. The person begins with a neutral, focused facial expression and hands clasped in front of their chest. (2) The person breaks into a vigorous, rhythmic dance as the music tempo increases. Their long hair swings wildly with every sharp turn of the head. Their hands perform a series of rapid, stylized mudras and gestures, pointing and waving in sync with the beat. The black fabric of their robe flows with the movement, and their facial expressions become exaggerated and energetic to match the song's vibe. (3) The movement becomes even more frantic as the person jumps and spins, their sunglasses remaining firmly in place. They use their hands to frame their face and chest, emphasizing the lyrics through dramatic physical acting. The indoor studio setting provides a clean, high-contrast backdrop that makes the person's all-black attire and dark hair stand out against the neutral-toned walls and flooring. (4) In the final phase, the person performs a series of quick-fire religious hand signs while lip-syncing intensely. Their mouth is wide open for the high notes, and their body maintains a high-arousal state with fast, jerky movements. The guitar and background lights remain static, providing a constant spatial anchor for the high-energy performance that concludes with a final, dramatic pose.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track begins with a brief period of studio silence before a male voice delivers a spoken introduction in Mandarin. The voice is calm, professional, and low-arousal, with a moderate pitch. There is no background music at this stage, and the recording quality is very clean, indicating a controlled indoor environment or high-quality microphone setup. (2) Suddenly, a high-tempo electronic pop beat enters with a very strong, rhythmic kick drum and synthesizer layers. The male vocal transitions into a high-arousal singing style, with a fast speech rate and dynamic pitch contours. The music has a clear major-mode feel with high energy, and the vocals are layered prominently over the driving instrumental track. (3) The audio shifts into a section where the vocals adopt a chanting quality, repeating traditional Buddhist phrases. Despite the religious lyrical content, the music remains a high-energy dance track with a constant BPM. The singer uses high intensity and loudness, with frequent rising and falling intonations that create a sense of dramatic, comedic urgency. (4) A piercing, high-pitched vocal run is executed with significant strain and power, cutting through the dense mix of the background music. The percussive elements of the track become more complex, with synthetic sound effects adding to the high-information density. The phase concludes with the music and vocals abruptly stopping, leaving a short tail of reverb in the quiet studio space.
